# TeleV

> TeleV is a free Telegram app for Android TV and Google TV. It shows the videos and live streams from a user's Telegram channels, groups and chats on the TV, with full remote control (D-pad) navigation. Telegram has no official Android TV app; TeleV is an independent, unofficial app built on TDLib, Telegram's official open-source library.

Key facts:

- Platform: Android TV and Google TV, Android 8.0 or newer. Available on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.telev.tv
- Price: free.
- Supported devices: Chromecast with Google TV, Google TV Streamer, Nvidia Shield TV, Xiaomi Mi Box, and Sony, TCL, Hisense and Philips Android TV / Google TV smart TVs.
- Not supported: Samsung (Tizen), LG (webOS), Amazon Fire TV, Roku, Apple TV. On those TVs, a Chromecast with Google TV adds TeleV.
- Sign-in: scan a QR code with the Telegram phone app (Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device), or use a phone number. Two-step verification is supported.
- Features: video playback from channels, groups and chats; live streams and video chats in real time with switching between active streams; continue watching; playback speed; favorite channels; search public channels; archived chats.
- Viewer only: TeleV can't send messages and never uses the microphone or camera.
- Privacy: TeleV connects the TV directly to Telegram; it has no analytics or ads and doesn't collect personal data.
- Languages: English and Hebrew; more languages are planned.
- Support: support@telev.app
- Updates channel on Telegram: https://t.me/telev (@telev)
